messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Save .Rdata file that is ~1gb in size
parts:
I have a list object that includes many .wav files. Together, the wav files are approaching 1gb in size. 

If I try to save the list object as a .Rdata file using save.image(), R crashes. 

Is there any way to maybe compress the the list object or any other workaround for this?

Thanks
Ross

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Save .Rdata file that is ~1gb in size
parts:
I would rather use save() as your workspace saved by save.image() may
contain many other stuff than your wav files.
Best,
Jerome

parts:
Hi Julie,

If you want to load the tico song you saved, you'd use the load() function rather than the data() function, e.g.

load("tico.RData")

The data() function is for loading built-in datasets.

Best,
Jesse Ross
